text:
maria: Heads up — p95/p99 series are missing from the latency ops dashboard after the metrics ingestion rollout ~10:30 PDT. Customers are noticing tail lines gone. Screenshot: (attached).

deploy-bot: Deployed metrics-ingest-transform v2 to production by josh at 2026-03-17T10:29:58Z :rocket:

josh: Thanks for the flag. Which dashboard URL? can someone paste the panel query?
alex: Dash URL: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/ops/latency-overview panel id=12. Query is a PromQL-style transform via our metrics pipeline: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le)).
michael: Running a quick check against the raw metric store now.
michael: curl -s "https://metrics-store/query?query=request_latency_ms_bucket&start=1610000000&end=1610000300" | jq '.data' -> returned empty array for that metric name.
josh: hmm — the ingest transform v2 changed the exported metric name to request_latency_ms_v2_bucket (we added a suffix for the new schema). Looks like dashboards still point at request_latency_ms_bucket.
alex: That would explain missing quantiles: histogram_quantile needs the _bucket series. If the buckets disappeared, p95/p99 lines will be blank.
maria: Can we alias the new name back to the old name or update the dashboard quickly? We need to restore customer-facing panels ASAP.
josh: I can push a hotfix to the aggregator to emit the legacy metric name as an alias. Will do a tight rollout to avoid destabilizing anything.
josh: Patching now...
deploy-bot: Started job metrics-compatibility-alias rollout (canary) by josh
michael: Confirming we see request_latency_ms_bucket samples appear in the raw store again (first canary hosts).
alex: Re-running histogram_quantile check: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le)) -> now returns non-empty series, p95 values present.
maria: Pulled the dashboard — p95 and p99 lines returned for the last 30m. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: Customer-facing incident note: "We addressed a metrics schema change that temporarily hid percentile lines from the latency dashboard; series are restored. Apology and follow-up sent."
josh: Follow-up task created: TKT-4192 — Add automated dashboard compatibility test for metric renames + add aliasing to transforms.
maria: Thanks all. Will reply to the customer thread and close after 24h monitoring. :)
